title: Rdma payload track
description:
In current version, NVMEoF RDMA dissector does not properly track RDMA transfers:
- missing tracking of RDMA transfers when handling from_host and to_host traffic, thus falling into wrong code path
- confusing requests with responses in the code, incorrect tracking.
- No decoding of RDMA payloads, and no matches to the commands.

I have laid the foundation for RDMA transfers tracking as follows:
- RDMA information exports address and size, in addition to key
- when command request is parsed, pending transfers are keyed as address, key, size vs command
- added support for decoding RDMA transfers in NVME-RDMA context
- When RDMA transfer request is seen, the command is looked up in transfer list (against a tuple of address, key and size)
- this allows transfer to be linked to command and command linked to transfer
- RDMA sequence number is cached in NVME RDMA queue, together with command link
- When RDMA transfer reply is seen, NVME queue is checked for sequence number match. This allows to match transfer of data to command and transfer request. This also allows to match transfer request against transfer itself. 
- Transfers are keyed in responses list (against sequence number). This allows repeated lookup of transfer frames.
- Since transfer is matches against the command, we can decode it. So far, only data payload for connect command is decoded.

commits_data.message:
NVME RDMA dissector: store RDMA transfers and link them to commands.

Details:
* At this point works for single RDMA transfer per command
* Commands are linked to RDMA requests
* RDMA requests are linked to commands (read and only first write)
* RDMA read requests are linked to read responses (only first response)
* RDMA read responses are linked to requests (only first response)
* RDMA read responses are linked to commands (only first response)
